The quarterly financial review was conducted by the finance department during the month of October. Quite significant discrepancies were identified in the expense reports that had been submitted by various department heads. An investigation was commenced by the compliance officer in order to facilitate the identification of the root causes of these very concerning issues that had been overlooked previously.

The utilization of legacy accounting software has been identified as a contributing factor to the problems that were encountered by the team. It was recommended by the IT department that a migration to the new system should be initiated as soon as possible. The decision was made by senior management to obtain additional resources and allocate them to this rather urgent matter that requires immediate attention.

Due to the fact that the migration process is somewhat complex and will necessitate cooperation from all stakeholders, it will be necessary for all department heads to provide their full cooperation and assistance. Training sessions will be organized by the HR department at this point in time to facilitate the transition. The completion of the migration is expected to occur by the end of Q1 of the upcoming fiscal year.
